title: Run Codex sub-agents with full access instead of the removed --full-auto flag
goal: Codex CLI 0.166 rejects exec --full-auto, so every Codex sub-run through the adaptive harness exits 2. Invoke codex exec --dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox --skip-git-repo-check - so Codex workers get the same non-interactive full permissions as the other CLI tools.
